obligations.source_text: For this independently allocated randomized arm, test whether a women-in-professional-uniform private security access-control concept remains visibly legible inside a complex biotech-laboratory visitor surge during a fire-alarm credential fallback, while using the supplied portrait only as facial and hair appearance guidance for an original adult fictional subject.

bindings.private_security_uniform_phrase: an adult private guard in a coherent non-police site uniform
bindings.credential_reader_phrase: compares one visitor credential with the access reader
bindings.entry_log_phrase: checks the approved entry list and access log
bindings.access_decision_phrase: confirms the visitor is approved for this facility
bindings.controlled_gate_consequence_phrase: green reader state opens one controlled gate
